title: Glowing pencil
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe066' stop-opacity='0.8'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#ffcc00' stop-opacity='0.3'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffcc00' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='bodyGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff9933'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#cc6600'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='tipGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe0b2'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffb74d'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Glow aura -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='45' ry='45' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- Pencil body -->
  <rect x='30' y='22' width='28' height='48' rx='2' fill='url(#bodyGrad)'/>
  <!-- Body stripe: lighter shade for edge -->
  <rect x='30' y='22' width='7' height='48' rx='2' fill='#ffb74d' opacity='0.6'/>
  <rect x='51' y='22' width='7' height='48' rx='2' fill='#a04d00' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Metal ferrule -->
  <rect x='29' y='16' width='30' height='8' rx='1' fill='#c0c8d0'/>
  <rect x='29' y='16' width='6' height='8' rx='1' fill='#e0e8f0'/>
  <rect x='53' y='16' width='6' height='8' rx='1' fill='#8899aa'/>
  <line x1='29' y1='19' x2='59' y2='19' stroke='#aab8c4' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <line x1='29' y1='22' x2='59' y2='22' stroke='#aab8c4' stroke-width='0.8'/>

  <!-- Eraser -->
  <rect x='30' y='10' width='28' height='7' rx='3' fill='#ff8a9e'/>
  <rect x='30' y='10' width='12' height='7' rx='3' fill='#ffb3c1'/>

  <!-- Wood cone -->
  <polygon points='30,70 58,70 44,93' fill='url(#tipGrad)'/>
  <polygon points='30,70 38,70 44,93' fill='#ffd699' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Graphite tip -->
  <polygon points='39,82 49,82 44,93' fill='#6d4c9a'/>
  <!-- Tip highlight -->
  <polygon points='39,82 42.5,82 44,93' fill='#a07cc4' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- Sparkle glow accents -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='90' r='2' fill='#ffe066' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='90' r='4' fill='#ffe066' opacity='0.3'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='35' r='1.5' fill='#fff3b3' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='25' cy='60' r='1.2' fill='#fff3b3' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='55' r='1' fill='#ffe066' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Small sparkle cross near tip -->
  <g opacity='0.7'>
    <line x1='52' y1='88' x2='56' y2='88' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='54' y1='86' x2='54' y2='90' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>
  <g opacity='0.5'>
    <line x1='22' y1='40' x2='25' y2='40' stroke='#fff3b3' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='23.5' y1='38.5' x2='23.5' y2='41.5' stroke='#fff3b3' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>
</svg>
